summary: Submitted an obligation that registers a second, separate sourced contract violation found while auditing the configuration/authority path. Claim claim-getconfiguration-reports-config-index (concern implementation_semantics): Raft.GetConfiguration must report the index of the configuration it returns, so callers can use it as the prevIndex guard accepted by the membership-change APIs and so Stats can report the real latest configuration index. Grounding: Raft.GetConfiguration builds its future from only the latest configuration value (api.go:895-903), leaving latestIndex unset, and configurationsFuture.Index returns exactly that field (future.go:262-270); two bindings anchor those declarations. The evidence is already retained from exploration check 86b51caa6a8141a9802f09aa24ea13af, whose event public_configuration_index showed a committed AddNonvoter with add_nonvoter_index 4, internal_config_index 4, public_config_index 0, index_reported_as_zero true, indexes_disagree true and identical public and internal server lists. Scope records the assumption that ConfigurationFuture.Index is documented as the index of the latest configuration in use, excludes the internal configurationsCh path that does return the full value, and carries a pending item about whether any in-tree caller depends on the zero value plus an unresolved note that populating it would be a behaviour change for any deployment that relied on zero. This observation is kept separate from the confirmed published-configuration violation through direct check 3b256fe6f42b4154b75d4d2ec02e27bf, which is unchanged. Preflight validation returned valid true. No source, evidence, credential or dependency files were modified; the draft contains submission.json, probe_config_publish_test.go and probe_config_index_test.go.
